Check a component the way publishing does on a server with a component build service: the module
against the component conformance suite, and its editor panel module, when it has one, against the
panel checks.

The argument is one of:
  a component's slug   a component of the working copy, .voidhash/components/<slug>
  a crate directory    built for release first, into target/voidhash/ in the crate
  a .wasm module       its panel is --panel, or a panel.wasm next to it

Building needs Rust with the wasm32-unknown-unknown target. The conformance suite is run by the
voidhash-guest-conformance executable, found on your PATH or named by VOIDHASH_CONFORMANCE.

Usage:
  voidhash test [component] [flags]

Arguments:
  component  A component of .voidhash/components, a component crate or a .wasm module (the current
             directory by default)

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show help for this command
      --panel <panel>  The editor panel module of a .wasm module (default: panel.wasm next to it)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash test
  voidhash test sale-badge
  voidhash test ./crates/wheel-picker
  voidhash test build/module.wasm --panel build/panel.wasm
